ChecklistPeriod.title: ChecklistPeriod
ChecklistPeriod.description: Monthly PJU inspection checklist sheet containing lamp cell statuses, custom 3-slot labels per cluster, general patrol notes, and PIC name.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching Firebase Auth.

month.description: Month name in uppercase Indonesian (e.g. NOVEMBER).

checks.description: Map of cell keys '{clusterId}_{slot}_{date}' to status string ('normal', 'warn', or 'error').

slotLabels.description: Map of clusterId string ('1'..'9') to list of 3 slot label strings.

generalNotes.description: Freeform patrol notes from the officer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when period sheet was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when period sheet was last updated.

PjuIssue.title: PjuIssue
PjuIssue.description: Structured PJU malfunction or maintenance issue report logged during patrol.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching Firebase Auth.

date.description: Day of the month (1..31) when issue was observed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when issue was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when issue was last updated.

/users/{userId}/periods/{periodId}.description: User-scoped monthly PJU checklist period documents.

/users/{userId}/periods/{periodId}/issue.description: User-scoped PJU issue reports belonging to a specific monthly period.
